name: emit the solution in a numeric file loadable as a vector
definition: Save the optimized vector to a plain numeric text file that a vector reader can parse back row-wise.
failure_mode: Wrong format, dtype, or path makes the vector unreadable or trivially wrong.

name: emit valid JSON Lines with the two required fields for every paper
definition: Produce one JSON object per paper with string id and official-code-URL fields, with exactly the right number of records.
failure_mode: Unparseable lines or missing entries fail the content/coverage checks.
